WITH account_trans AS (
  SELECT 
    a.account_id,
    a.frequency,
    AVG(CASE 
      WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
      WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount
      ELSE NULL
    END) as avg_signed_amount,
    AVG(t.balance) as avg_balance
  FROM account a
  JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.frequency
),
freq_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    frequency,
    AVG(avg_signed_amount) as freq_avg_signed,
    AVG(avg_balance) as freq_avg_balance
  FROM account_trans
  GROUP BY frequency
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(freq_avg_signed) as mean_signed FROM freq_stats
),
filtered_freqs AS (
  SELECT 
    f.freq_avg_signed,
    f.freq_avg_balance,
    f.freq_avg_signed - om.mean_signed as excess
  FROM freq_stats f, overall_mean om
  WHERE f.freq_avg_signed > om.mean_signed
)
SELECT 
  AVG(freq_avg_signed) as avg_of_avg_signed,
  AVG(freq_avg_balance) as avg_of_avg_balance,
  AVG(excess) as avg_excess
FROM filtered_freqs
